sentences.ar: الولدين ركضوا وما وقفوا لحد البلد.
sentences.en: The two boys ran and did not stop until the town.

sentences.ar: توم قال: إذا حكينا، جو بيقتلنا.
sentences.en: Tom said: if we speak, Joe will kill us.
They wrote a paper and swore to keep silent.
They buried the paper under a tree.

sentences.ar: من هديك الليلة، ما عاد توم ينام منيح.
sentences.en: From that night, Tom no longer slept well.
